messages:
sara_support: FYI customer BrightLearn opened a ticket — their daily usage chart and CSV export don't align. dashboard shows 2025-11-12 total 9,200 tokens, CSV shows 6,800 on 11/12 and 2,400 on 11/11. they're in Asia/Kolkata (IST +05:30).
asha_csm: cc @sara_support — they say billing appears correct but product metrics look split across two dates. impact: analytics dashboards for product team.
daan_eng: Can you paste a minimal CSV snippet and the org timezone settings? Also any export id / job id.
sara_support: Export job id: exp_9247_20251112. CSV rows (sanitized):
```
org_id,ts_iso,consumption
brightlearn,2025-11-11T23:45:10+00:00,1200
brightlearn,2025-11-12T00:05:30+00:00,2400
brightlearn,2025-11-12T14:12:01+00:00,6800
```
They said org timezone in console is set to Asia/Kolkata. Dashboard top-right shows "Day: local timezone".
jenna_data: Interesting — CSV timestamps are in UTC. If export is written with UTC date bins but UI is doing date_trunc with org tz, that can shift events around (IST is +5:30). But the CSV split at 00:05 UTC corresponds to 05:35 IST which is same local day, hmm.
tim_sre: I grabbed the export job logs: `exporter: started job exp_9247_20251112, window_start=2025-11-12T00:00:00Z, window_end=2025-11-13T00:00:00Z` — looks like exporter used UTC day window. What does the dashboard query use?
daan_eng: The dashboard query layer constructs daily aggregates with `date_trunc('day', (ts at time zone org_tz))` — that should use org tz. But the export path uses the ingestion bucket's partition by `date_trunc('day', ts)` which is UTC by default. So yes, mismatch.
asha_csm: Customer expects exports to align with the console day-break (per org tz). Could be a big problem for teams reconciling numbers. They asked for a remediation and ETA.
jenna_data: Workaround for them: re-run export with `--tz Asia/Kolkata` flag on the export tool (we can do a manual job). I'll prepare a corrected CSV and send.
daan_eng: Root cause summary for ENG: two code paths — analytics query uses org TZ, export and backend partitioning uses UTC fixed window. Need to either (A) make exports respect org tz, or (B) document that exports are UTC-windowed. Prefer (A).
infra-bot: Incident recorded: INC-2025-4413 created by daan_eng for "export vs dashboard day-boundary mismatch (org tz)". Priority: P2.
tim_sre: Quick ask: any customers on DST zones affected? IST isn't DST, but EU/US customers will see DST edge cases if we switch naive conversions. Need test coverage.
daan_eng: Agreed. Plan: (1) hotfix export tool to accept org_tz param and apply `ts AT TIME ZONE org_tz` when bucketing; (2) add end-to-end test with multiple tzs incl DST; (3) surface export timezone in UI and API. Estimated 3-4 days for a full rollout, can patch support with manual corrected CSV within 24 hours.
sara_support: I'll reply to BrightLearn with the manual CSV offer + ETA and ask if they'd like us to re-run exports historically for their billing month.
asha_csm: Please tag me on the support reply. Also let's collect a small customer impact list to escalate to PM if more than 3 customers affected.
daan_eng: I'll start a PR and link INC-2025-4413. Assigning to @daan_eng, review @jenna_data, ops check @tim_sre.
jenna_data: Adding tests to the analytics repo. I'll also run a diff on last 30 days for BrightLearn to quantify divergence.
sara_support: Thanks — I updated the ticket with notes and pinged customer.
asha_csm: Thx team. @sara_support please flag if customer escalates to billing immediately, we'll prioritize.
(reacts: :thumbsup: from sara_support, daan_eng)
